I heard that some of the exits are now under someone's control, and they're only letting in their own kind. Which means no more outsiders will be allowed in. It may take some finesse, but for a true warrior, such obstacles shouldn't be a problem.}} ==Objectives== * Locate the secret exfil on [[Customs]] ** (''Optional'') Obtain the [[Note with code word Voron|special item]] to extract through the secret exfil ==Rewards== * +6,600 [[EXP]] * [[Jaeger]] Rep '''+0.01''' * 32,000 Roubles ** 33,600 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 36,800 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 2× [[CMS surgical kit]] {{quote|You've learned your lesson. Your knowledge of the terrain, the paths between the areas and safe escape routes is your strength.}} ==Guide== In this quest you have to visit either of the 2 hidden extractions on [[Customs]].
